label: Vitres du palais
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production albedo texture for a faithful modern Jak 3 remaster.
Input image: original game texture, EDIT TARGET. Keep the exact composition and UV layout; faithfully reconstruct the same surface with realistic fine detail.
Primary request: 1024x1024 square. Original old ochre smoked glass panels with slim dark bronze polygonal borders. Preserve every polygon boundary and its exact position, border widths, and warm subdued beige/brown palette. Fine uneven hand-made glass, tiny bubbles, subtle age and faint dusty perimeter; glass centres clean enough to transmit light. Do not paint a room, scenery, reflections, cracks, light rays or change the panel design.
Constraints: preserve the original large-scale pattern, coordinates of all features, tile scale, color balance and average brightness. Realistic materials within Jak's stylized world, no redesign. Flat orthographic surface filling the entire image; no perspective, margins, text or watermark. No cast shadows, directional lighting or painted specular highlights. Original repeat must match across boundaries. Opaque RGB output; game alpha mask is reapplied separately. Do not add any objects, seams or decorations absent from the original.
